title: JKSSB under fire as FAA exam cheating racket triggers protests

ai.summary: Protesters in Srinagar demanded transparency in JKSSB recruitment after alleged cheating in the Accounts Assistant exam, citing a decade of irregularities that have led to cancelled exams and investigations.

facts.claim: alleged cheating in the Accounts Assistant exam
facts.quote: The latest protests follow the alleged cheating operation detected in connection with the Accounts Assistant examination held on November 15.

facts.claim: three JKSSB examinations cancelled in 2022 and 2023
facts.quote: Three JKSSB examinations were cancelled in 2022 and 2023 due to irregularities.

facts.claim: unemployment rate in J&K at 9.4% for 15+ years
facts.quote: Jammu and Kashmir recorded an unemployment rate of 9.4 percent among persons aged 15 years and above during July-September 2026, compared with 5.1 percent nationally.

ai.background_note: The protests are part of a decade-long pattern of recruitment controversies in Jammu and Kashmir, with repeated cancellations and allegations of irregularities affecting government job aspirants.
